svg.title: Heterogeneity, delay and update-gap limitations
svg.desc: Homogeneous versus heterogeneous N=120 means use filled versus open markers. Policy colours and shapes remain consistent. Delay sensitivity and observed maximum completed gaps retain unfavourable results; vertical ranges are not confidence intervals.
